name: ShapeFactory
summary: Free browser design tools: logo maker, color palette generator, CSS gradient generator and duotone image effects.
description: A set of small free browser tools built by designers. Logo creates logos, Pigment generates color palettes from lighting and pigment instead of math, Gradient builds chromatic gradients in the LAB color space and copies the CSS, and Duotone applies duotone effects to stock photos or your own uploads. The homepage also lists a GalleryQR tool.
contains: free tools: Logo, Pigment, Gradient and Duotone, plus GalleryQR listed on the homepage
Pigment: palettes based on lighting and pigment instead of math
Gradient: LAB color space gradients with copy-ready CSS
Duotone: free duotone images or custom duotone effects from an upload
